description: This pie chart illustrates a comparison between two categories, labeled "Efficient deployment" and "Reduction." The chart consists of a total of two slices. The larger slice, colored orange, is labeled "Reduction" on the outside and includes the values "60.9s" and "(69.92%)" written inside the segment. The smaller slice, colored blue, is labeled "Efficient deployment" on the outside and contains the value "26.2s" inside, with a small grey rectangular artifact appearing just below this text. The blue "Efficient deployment" slice is visually emphasized by being exploded, or slightly offset, from the main body of the chart. There is no separate legend provided, as the category labels are positioned directly adjacent to their corresponding slices, and the quantitative data labels are embedded directly within the segments.
